# ALVEX Handel GmbH

> ALVEX Handel GmbH is an internationally operating B2B trading company based in Frankfurt am Main, Germany, specialised in the distribution of high-purity sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃, sodium hydrogen carbonate, "Natron") in bulk. ALVEX supplies food, feed, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, cleaning, industrial, water-treatment and environmental sectors, with reliable logistics and volume-tiered fixed-price offers. The company serves Germany and international markets.

## Company

- Legal name: ALVEX Handel GmbH
- Location: Steinweg 3, 60313 Frankfurt am Main, Germany
- Contact: info@alvexhandel.com · +49 (0) 69 9505 7680
- Business: B2B distribution and wholesale of sodium bicarbonate in bulk (bags, big bags, sling bags, bulk)
- Markets served: Germany and worldwide (active international interest incl. Paraguay)

## Product

- Product: Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO₃) from natural trona ore
- CAS No.: 144-55-8 · EINECS No.: 205-633-8 · Molecular weight: 84.01 g/mol
- Grades: Food grade (NaHCO₃ ≥ 99.3%), Feed grade (NaHCO₃ ≥ 99.3%), Technical grade (NaHCO₃ ≥ 99.1%)
- Synonyms: sodium hydrogen carbonate, sodium acid carbonate, baking soda, bicarbonate of soda, Natron
